grasp_0.description: this grasp point is located on the rim of the trash can

plane_0.description: The first plane is a horizontal plane defined by the rim of the trash can. Its centroid is located at the geometric center of the circular opening of the rim

plane_1.description: The second plane is also a horizontal plane defined by the base of the trash can. Its centroid is positioned at the geometric center of the trash can's bottom surface, and this plane is parallel to the rim plane.
